model.name: ChangeRequest shape — Task master-list (authoritative) + Test parent + affected-units children (Tron verbatim, supersedes R40.60 parent=Task)
model.description: The ChangeRequest traceability SHAPE per Tron verbatim ('the task has a list of CR as master … each CR needs to parent to a test that has to be reevaluated from task traced down to the test … so the CR has all traceability units as children that are affected to be changed'). THREE links, each authoritative for a different fact: (1) Task->CRs MASTER = task.changeRequests[] is the AUTHORITATIVE Task->CR list (the server.ts:1391 'losable mirror' comment is now WRONG); (2) CR->Test PARENT = ChangeRequest.ownerIor -> ior:class:Test (the Test that must be re-evaluated/changed to resolve the CR; renders under the Test); (3) CR->affected units CHILDREN = CR.affects[] = the traceability units along Task->covered-Requirement->UseCase->Class->Method->Impl->Test that must change for the fix to land. SUPERSEDES R40.60's CR-ownerIor->Task ruling — Tron reverses it: parent IS the Test. The band (R40.60 deriveTaskStatus) finds a task's CRs by model.task backref (server.ts:1441), so parent=Test does not disturb it. ★ FLAGGED DEFECT (bring fix-shape, do NOT silently fix): task.changeRequests[] is EMPTY on ALL tasks (0 carry it) while CR units exist (found only via model.task backref) — under Tron's model the empty master list is a DEFECT; gated backfill decided by PO.

ONE master (the task list); the backref MUST equal it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CR.affects[] = the traceability units along the Task->…->Test trace that must change for the fix to land consistently; the CR is the CONTAINER of what changes and renders CR -> affected-units (forward children, hasChildren from affects[].length). Each affects[] ref is a REAL unit on the Task->Test trace.

gateRef.assertion: every CR.affects[] ref resolves to a real unit on the Task->Test trace; a dangling/off-trace affects-ref => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Resolving a CR raised at a Task traces DOWN Task->coveredRequirement->UseCase->Class->Method->Impl->Test; the Test(s) needing change = the CR's parent(s), the units on that path that must change = affects[]. CR.status -> Resolved ONLY when the parent Test re-evaluates GREEN WITH the change (evidence-gated, NOT stamped) — so the change lands consistently across the chain.

gateRef.assertion: CR.status->Resolved requires the parent Test green-with-change evidence; a stamp-without-reeval => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: stamp CR Resolved without the parent-Test green-with-change -> RED

SAME FAMILY as the unwired-guard (check-status-symbol exists + passed a scan + nothing enforced it) and the number-allocation wrong-surface: it EXISTS, a scan sees the requirement, and nothing enforces that a TASK implements each AC. SYSTEMIC ASK (planner + architect): can we DETECT ACs with NO implementing task? (a gate: an AC with no covering task => flagged; gate-beats-procedure).
